```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
# Load cfbstats from the checkout when the package is not installed, so the
# site build does not require a package install (decision 0030).
if (!requireNamespace("cfbstats", quietly = TRUE)) {
  dir <- getwd()
  while (!file.exists(file.path(dir, "_targets")) && dirname(dir) != dir) {
    dir <- dirname(dir)
  }
  for (src in sort(list.files(file.path(dir, "R"), pattern = "[.]R$", full.names = TRUE))) {
    source(src, local = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")
  }
}
library(dplyr)
library(targets)
# altdoc renders in a temp dir; point the knit wd at the project root so
# tar_read() and inst/ paths resolve (set by CFBSTATS_ROOT in CI/site build).
root <- cfbstats_root()
if (nzchar(root)) knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
```

```{r}
#| label: registry
#| include: false
# Standard: key on athlete id, never name (recruiting ids collide — decision
# 0013). Declare every subject's ids here so the prose below never hard-codes a
# name-based lookup.
subjects <- tibble::tribble(
  ~who,          ~cfb_athlete_id, ~gsis_id,
  "Example One", "0000000",       "00-0000000"
)
```
